title: The Legend of Lylah Clare
description: A filmmaker manipulates a starlet into the image of his late wife, a celebrated actress who met a tragic death.

title: Untamed Youth
description: Vagrant sisters (Mamie Van Doren, Lori Nelson) work for crooked characters at a rock 'n' roll prison-farm.

title: Teenage Doll
description: After killing a member of a teenage gang in a fight over her boyfriend, a girl seeks the protection of his gang.

title: The Graduate
description: An aimless college man (Dustin Hoffman) lets an older woman (Anne Bancroft) seduce him, then finds himself falling for her daughter (Katharine Ross).

title: The Miracle Worker
description: Teacher Anne Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) leads deaf and blind Helen Keller (Patty Duke) out of darkness.

title: The Pumpkin Eater
description: A Londoner (Anne Bancroft) with several children leaves her second husband for a screenwriter (Peter Finch), who fools around.

title: The Prisoner of Second Avenue
description: An advertising executive loses his job and his sanity because of the recession and the hectic pace of Manhattan life.

title: The Sunshine Boys
description: After a long separation, two former vaudeville partners reunite to renew their friendship and their feud.

title: Arena
description: Left by his wife (Polly Bergen), a vain rodeo star (Gig Young) picks up a floozy (Jean Hagen) and rides a bad Brahman bull.

title: Banjo
description: A Georgia orphan (Sharyn Moffett) and her dog, Banjo, go to live with her Boston aunt (Jacqueline White), who sends Banjo back.

title: Child of Divorce
description: The divorce of her parents (Regis Toomey, Madge Meredith) breaks a little girl's (Sharyn Moffett) heart.

title: Bodyguard
description: An ousted Los Angeles homicide detective (Lawrence Tierney) goes to work for a widow and is framed for murder.

title: Trapped
description: An ex-counterfeiter (Lloyd Bridges) leads an undercover agent (John Hoyt) to a gang using his best plates.

title: Follow Me Quietly
description: A police detective (William Lundigan) and a newswoman (Dorothy Patrick) hunt a rainy-day strangler dubbed the Judge.

title: Armored Car Robbery
description: A Los Angeles policeman (Charles McGraw) hunts the mastermind (William Talman) of a theft gang that killed his partner.

title: The Narrow Margin
description: Hit men board a train to kill a racketeer's widow (Marie Windsor) escorted by a Los Angeles detective (Charles McGraw).

title: The Last Run
description: A retired mob getaway driver (George C. Scott) agrees to take a fugitive (Tony Musante) across the Spanish border to France.

title: Soylent Green
description: Future New Yorkers live on a trademarked food, which two detectives (Charlton Heston, Edward G. Robinson) find has a secret ingredient.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
description: Supercomputer HAL 9000 guides astronauts (Keir Dullea, Gary Lockwood, William Sylvester) on a trip to find the origins of humans.

title: A Clockwork Orange
description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society.

title: Barry Lyndon
description: Thackeray's 18th-century Irish rogue (Ryan O'Neal) woos and wins a rich widow (Marisa Berenson), then plays aristocrat.

title: Jeanne Dielman, 23 Quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
description: A widow (Delphine Seyrig) lives with her young son (Jan Decorte), goes about her daily routine and turns tricks in the afternoon.

title: Romance
description: An opera star (Greta Garbo) kept by an older man (Lewis Stone) falls in love with a preacher (Gavin Gordon) from a rich American family.

title: Mata Hari
description: An exotic dancer (Greta Garbo) spies for the Germans, seducing Russian officers (Ramon Novarro, Lionel Barrymore) in World War I.

title: Susan Lenox: Her Fall and Rise
description: A farmer's daughter (Greta Garbo) knows other men as a woman of the world, yet searches for the man (Clark Gable) she loves.

title: Anna Karenina
description: Tragic Anna (Greta Garbo) leaves her cold husband (Basil Rathbone) for dashing Count Vronsky (Fredric March) in 19th-century Russia.

title: Conquest
description: Married Countess Marie Walewska (Greta Garbo) becomes Napoleon's (Charles Boyer) mistress, followed by the battle of Waterloo.

title: Ninotchka
description: A playboy (Melvyn Douglas) charms a Russian envoy (Greta Garbo) sent to fetch three wayward comrades in Paris.

title: Two-Faced Woman
description: A woman (Greta Garbo) poses as her tempting twin sister to test her husband's (Melvyn Douglas) fidelity in Manhattan.

title: Beyond The Border: Latino Representation In Hollywood
description: Beyond The Border: Latino Representation In Hollywood

title: My Family/Mi Familia
description: The narrated saga of a Mexican-American family reflects the 20th-century growth of the Los Angeles Latino community.

title: Giant
description: A cattleman (Rock Hudson) and his spoiled wife (Elizabeth Taylor) watch an upstart oilman (James Dean) try to take over Texas.

title: Bordertown
description: A journalist (Jennifer Lopez) probes the murders of hundreds of Mexican women near a Juarez factory owned by a U.S. company.

title: A Night at the Opera
description: Groucho, Chico and Harpo go to Italy and bring opera and its patrons down to their level.

title: At the Circus
description: A sly lawyer (Groucho Marx) and a pair of carnies (Harpo Marx, Chico Marx) shoot a society matron (Margaret Dumont) out of a cannon and try to save a circus.

title: Batman and Robin
description:
S01 E12 — Robin Rides the Wind
Batman and Robin get blueprints for a device that will neutralize the Wizard's remote control machine.

title: The People vs. Dr. Kildare
description: An ice skater sues Kildare (Lew Ayres) for malpractice after his roadside first aid leaves her paralyzed.

title: Merrie Melodies
description:
A Gander at Mother Goose
A collection of short gags based on classic nursery rhymes and fairy tales.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Goldimouse and the Three Cats
While father cat (Sylvester), mother cat and the child brat go for a walk, Goldimouse enters their home, eats their food and sleeps in all their beds.

title: The Blues Accordin' to Lightnin' Hopkins
description: A portrait of the blues musician from Texas, Lightnin' Hopkins.

title: Hot Pepper
description: The life and work of Zydeco artist Clifton Chenier.

title: They Came to Rob Las Vegas
description: A blackjack dealer (Gary Lockwood), his girlfriend (Elke Sommer) and his gang make an armored car disappear in the desert.

title: Springfield Rifle
description: A Union major (Gary Cooper) with a wife (Phyllis Thaxter) and son goes undercover as a traitor to stop a Confederate raider (David Brian).

title: I Died a Thousand Times
description: Bank robber Roy Earle (Jack Palance) pays for a disabled girl's (Lori Nelson) surgery, then meets his doom in the High Sierra.

title: To Sir, With Love
description: Unable to find employment in his field, a black engineer accepts a teaching position in a tough East End London school.

title: A Piece of the Action
description: Two con men (Sidney Poitier, Bill Cosby) are persuaded by a retired policeman (James Earl Jones) to volunteer their services to a ghetto youth center.

title: The Long Night
description: Tragedy looms when a war veteran (Henry Fonda) and a magician (Vincent Price) vie for the love of the same woman (Barbara Bel Geddes).

title: Badlands
description: A thrill-seeking teenage girl joins a garbage man on a South Dakota killing spree.
